option_relations.rationale: Decompensated biventricular heart failure (HFrEF) is a specific type of acute decompensated heart failure, making it a supertype of the more general leaf.

Arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy with pre-excitation (e.g., Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome) is a distinct cardiac condition and not directly related to acute decompensated heart failure as a cause, manifestation, or treatment.

Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) pattern with heart failure exacerbation describes a specific scenario where heart failure exacerbation (a form of acute decompensated heart failure) is present, making it a supertype of the general leaf.
Decompensated heart failure is clinically equivalent to Acute decompensated heart failure.
